736090162.eligibility: 501(c)(3) nonprofits only. At least 40% of total project cost must already be raised from other public donors (named) before consideration; borrowed funds, internal or reserve funds, government funds and undesignated donations do not count. A declined applicant waits one year to reapply; a grantee waits two years after payment before applying for another project.
736090162.geographic_limits: Projects must be located in Texas, Oklahoma, New Mexico, Arkansas, Missouri or Kansas
736090162.grant_range_stated: Up to 20% of total project cost, capped at $2,000,000
736090162.how_to_apply: Read the guidelines, then use the Apply link on the site to the online application (grantrequest.com). Existing applicants continue in the yourcausegrants.com portal. Questions go through the site's contact page.

736090162.not_funded: Private foundations; government-owned or operated institutions; debt retirement; endowments; projects already under construction or with a signed contractor; operating or program support; individuals; K-12 capital projects (except schools serving students with intellectual or developmental disabilities); renovation of leased property (unless a long-term ownership-like lease); requests only for land, furnishings, equipment (other than major medical equipment), vehicles or museum exhibits; local church bodies, congregations or parishes
